correctness.rationale: Over characteristic two the adjacency is dI plus the sum of the coordinate all-ones operators. On odd factors the all-ones operator is a projection; signed parity sums of its tensor multiplicities give h₀,h₁, both positive. On even factors each operator has one rank-one square-zero block and qᵢ−2 trivial blocks. The sum N is square-zero because the factors commute. On a tensor block with any two-dimensional square-zero factor, a contracting map in that factor satisfies NH+HN=I: the contributions from every other factor cancel in characteristic two. Thus rank N is (V−C)/2, positive, and the two adjacency sectors have kernel dimensions z₀,z₁ for their nilpotent parts. The wave is invertible, with T²−I=A T on the two-row space. On A=N this gives fixed dimensions z₀ and 2z₀ at 1 and 2, and T⁴=I. On A=I+N there are no fixed vectors except zero at 1, T³=diag(A,A), and T⁶=I. This gives every entry of the fixed table by adding dimensions and using the gcd of the time and the sector order. Strict inclusions of the fixing spaces give least periods 2 and 4 in the first sector and 3 and 6 in the second; zero gives 1, and joining 4 and 3 gives 12. Inverting the fixed counts and dividing by the least period gives the orbit census. An independent binary rank calculation for K₂□K₂□K₃ reproduced ranks 22,20,14,16,4,0 for Tᵗ−I and hence the six tabulated populations and 1310700 primitive twelve-cycles.
residual_risks: The independent matrix check is a single graph over F₂; its extension to all mixed sizes and all fields of characteristic two rests on the algebraic proof.

originality.rationale: Inspected sources cover the reversible second-order construction and closely related exact wave censuses. They do not furnish the mixed Cartesian-clique modular rank and multiplicity data needed for these closed counts with unequal alphabet sizes. The exact order twelve is not unprecedented on other graph families. The supported distinction is its uniform occurrence and the explicit census on this family, not novelty of the update or of Möbius inversion.
residual_risks: The literature search was bounded and one cited background paper was not accessible. Date matches among Resultary records do not settle priority.

value.rationale: Natural reversible dynamics on Cartesian clique products can have huge state spaces even for small products. The explicit counts for every period, over every characteristic-two state field and without equal factor sizes, replace enumeration and explain how local parity produces a sharp combined period and all its divisors. The nontrivial tensor rank is informative independently of the example and the standard orbit inversion.
residual_risks: These are labelled temporal cycles, not classes modulo spatial automorphisms.
